evidence.decision: Classifies dimmed information by both sensitivity and useful glance context.
evidence.artifact: Requires active/dimmed pairs with redaction and update rules.
evidence.transformation: Medication view settles a moving chart and preserves control positions during redaction.
evidence.verification: Fails unintended exposure, illegible primary content, layout jumps and excessive updates.
evidence.applicability: Limits support to snapshot device contexts and separates energy/device checks from static design.
evidence.handoffs: Privacy, Motion and watch design routes depend on the identified exposure/movement/task problem.
evidence.distinctiveness: Stable unavailable controls and resting animation distinguish dimmed presentation from generic loading.
